description: This file defines a React component named SignOutView and a wrapper SignOutWrapper for a sign-out page within a web application. It manages user interactions related to signing out of sessions and workspace data.

classes.name: SignOutView
classes.description: A React functional component that renders the sign-out interface, allowing users to sign out from other sessions, manage sessions, or sign out from the current workspace.

classes.name: SignOutWrapper
classes.description: A React functional component that conditionally renders either the SignOutView or ClearSessionDataView based on whether the user has an account.

methods.name: SignOutView
methods.description: Main component rendering sign-out options and handling user interactions for session management.

methods.name: SignOutWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper component that selects between SignOutView and ClearSessionDataView based on account state.
